description: src/core/output.ts lists 'path' under METADATA_KEYS (deny wins), but bs content toc --flat builds Topic.path by joining instructor-authored module titles with ' / ' (PRD 6.2 says --flat yields one row per topic with path). Options: (a) rename the row key (e.g. modulePath) and add it to CONTENT_KEYS, (b) special-case 'path' when its value is derived from titles, (c) accept and document. bs-kzf kept the PRD key name and did not touch src/core/output.ts (out of scope for a command ticket).
